notes: Gen 3: Snorlax's Tackle hits Pidgeot; next turn its Mimic at Pidgeot fails (it knows the Splash it would copy). A failed move is no attack Mirror Move can copy — pokeemerald's `MOVEEND_MIRROR_MOVE` skips `MOVE_RESULT_NO_EFFECT` — so Pidgeot's Mirror Move copies the Tackle; Showdown's gen3 `tryMoveHit` recorded the failed Mimic, and the I173 patch records no failure (issues.md I173, DESIGN.md R-M8-143; R-M8-80 pinned Showdown's behavior)
